label: Hammer Attack
description: 20 dmg (+10 per Creature Summon stack); 25% chance to stun.

label: Creature Summon
description: Gain a Creature Summon stack (max 3). Each stack adds +10 dmg to Hammer Attack.

label: Unleash the Beast
description: AOE damage: 15 per Creature Summon stack. Consumes all stacks. Requires at least 1 stack.

label: Heal
description: Heals a single ally for 30 HP.

label: Page Turner
description: Heals Erika 20 HP and removes negative status effects (stun/bind/burn) from all allies.

label: Cutesy Magic
description: Deals 10 damage to a single opponent; ignores 30% DEF.

label: Angelic Radiance
description: Deals 25 piercing AOE damage to all enemies and heals all allies 25 HP.

label: Warning Shot
description: Stuns one opponent (1). While Kimura Special is active, deals 10 piercing damage instead.

label: Piercing Volley
description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one opponent. While Kimura Special is active, hits all enemies for 35 instead.
extra: {"altIf":"kimura","altTarget":"aoe_enemy","altActions":[{"kind":"damage","base":35,"ignore":1}],"altDesc":"Kimura Special active: 35 piercing damage to all enemies."}

label: Kimura Special
description: For 2 turns: Warning Shot deals 10 piercing dmg instead of stunning, and Piercing Volley becomes a 35 piercing AOE.

label: Reload and Cover
description: Free. Jett becomes invulnerable this turn, clears Kimura Special, and gains 20 SP.

label: Heavy Slash
description: 40 dmg to one opponent; stuns Shou next turn. While Arahabaki is active, deals 80 dmg with no self-stun.

label: Conjure the Elements
description: 15 AOE damage to enemies, 5 AOE damage to allies. While Arahabaki is active, deals 30/15 instead.
extra: {"altIf":"arahabaki","altActions":[{"kind":"damage","base":30},{"kind":"damage","base":15,"target":"aoe_team"}],"altDesc":"Arahabaki active: 30 AOE damage to enemies, 15 AOE damage to allies."}

label: Arahabaki
description: For 4 turns: Shou takes 10 self-damage per turn. Heavy Slash becomes 80 dmg with no self-stun, and Conjure the Elements becomes 30/15 AOE.

label: Self Preservation
description: Heals Shou 60 HP; deals 10 damage to each other living ally. Unusable if all allies are dead.

label: Fiery Punch
description: 30 dmg with 50% chance to burn (2). While Intangible Flames is active, deals 5 dmg with a guaranteed burn instead.

label: Intangible Flames
description: For 3 turns, Maako can't be targeted by enemy attacks.

label: Flames of Reckoning
description: Requires Intangible Flames active. 30 AOE damage and burns (2) all enemies. Ends Intangible Flames.

label: Fire Wall
description: Makes an ally invulnerable for one turn. While Intangible Flames is active, also burns that ally.

label: Charm-shuriken
description: Deals 10 damage and afflicts the target with Charm.

label: Love Illusion
description: Star becomes invulnerable for 1 turn; deals 15 unguardable damage to every Charmed enemy and removes their Charm.

label: Kiss of Death
description: Deals 50 unguardable damage to every Charmed enemy and removes their Charm. Requires at least one Charmed enemy.

label: Broken Heart
description: Stuns every Charmed enemy and removes their Charm. Requires at least one Charmed enemy.

label: Ball & Chain
description: Deals 20 damage to one opponent. If they're bound by Binding Chain, deals 40 unguardable damage instead and releases the bind.

label: Chain Dance
description: Stack up to 3 times. Each stack adds 25 unguardable damage to Half-moon Melee.

label: Half-moon Melee
description: Deals 25 unguardable damage per Chain Dance stack to one opponent. Consumes all stacks. Requires at least 1 stack.

label: Spear Chuck
description: Deals 25 damage to one opponent. +5 damage for each consecutive turn it's used in a row.

label: Warrior Spirit
description: Gain an extra +5 SP per turn for 3 turns. Stacks with itself if used again before it expires.

label: Unyielding Barrage
description: Deals 70 damage to one opponent; Sendara can't act for 2 turns afterward. Can't be used the turn right after Spear Chuck.

label: Stand Your Ground
description: For 2 turns, damage taken is reduced by 50%; Sendara can't act next turn.

label: Mace Bash
description: Deals 15 damage (+10 per Lightning Charge stack) with a 50% chance to stun.

label: Lightning Charge
description: Stack up to 3 times. Each stack adds +10 damage to Kenshin's attacks. Can't be used while Rock Armor is stacked.

label: Rock Armor
description: Stack up to 3 times. Each stack reduces incoming damage by 25%. Can't be used while Lightning Charge is stacked.

label: Elemental Barrage
description: Deals 30 AOE damage. Causes burn if Lightning Charge is stacked, or stun if Rock Armor is stacked. Stacks are removed after use.

label: Imbue with Light
description: For 3 turns, Kairu has a 50% chance to dodge all incoming attacks.

label: Bo Staff Strike
description: Deals 20 damage to one opponent. Causes stun if Imbue with Light is active.

label: Flash Kick
description: Deals 50 damage to one opponent. Causes stun if Imbue with Light is active.

label: Light of Life
description: Heals Kairu 25 HP. If Imbue with Light is active, heals all allies 25 HP instead. Removes Imbue with Light.
